heading: Continuing offence.
text: In the case of a continuing offence, a fresh period of limitation shall begin to run at every moment of the time during which the offence continues.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, 02 of 1974 (Rep., Act 46 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
